## WeekFlow 1.1

**Download:** Windows: `WeekFlow-Setup.exe` · Linux: `WeekFlow-x86_64.AppImage` (any distro) or `weekflow_amd64.deb` (Ubuntu/Debian). Install steps are in the README.

### New
- Linux support (AppImage and .deb)
- Built-in updates from this page
- Task statuses: To do, In progress, On hold, Complete
- Completed page: browse finished work and reopen anything that isn't really done
- My Week shows each day as a wide, easy-to-read row

### Fixed
- Freeze on first launch with some graphics drivers
- Smaller, one-click Windows installer
